title: Building a Scalable Climate Coalition for Heavy Industry
abstract: Since greenhouse gases are a global pollutant, every country benefits from other countries’ mitigation efforts. Recent developments in climate and trade policy create an opportunity to address this coordination problem. This piece describes a climate coalition that builds on that opportunity, initially focused on four emissions-intensive industries: steel, aluminum, cement, and nitrogen fertilizers. Coalition members commit to domestic carbon pricing in covered industries, apply border carbon adjustments to imports from non-members, and deploy complementary incentives to encourage participation by low- and middle-income countries. Using plant-level data and trade modeling, we estimate a potential coalition’s effects on emissions, revenues, output, and prices. The results indicate that a first-wave coalition could achieve meaningful emissions reductions while limiting leakage, preserving competitiveness, respecting fairness, and generating substantial public revenue.
abstract_zh: 由于温室气体是一种全球性污染物，每个国家都会从其他国家的减排努力中受益。气候与贸易政策的最新发展为解决这一协调难题创造了机会。本文描述了一个建立在这一机会之上的气候联盟，其最初聚焦于四个排放密集型行业：钢铁、铝、水泥和氮肥。联盟成员承诺在覆盖行业实施国内碳定价，对来自非成员国的进口产品实施边境碳调节，并部署互补性激励措施，以鼓励中低收入国家参与。利用工厂层面数据和贸易模型，我们估计了潜在联盟对排放、财政收入、产出和价格的影响。结果表明，第一波联盟可以实现有意义的减排，同时限制碳泄漏、保持竞争力、尊重公平，并产生可观的公共收入。

title: Climate Crisis and Policy Inaction in Indonesia
abstract: We surveyed voters and politicians in advance of the 2024 Indonesian election to measure preferences for environmental policy. We find that politicians underestimate voter concerns. We conducted an informational experiment with politicians to correct these misperceptions, and we document evidence of learning but no greater support for policy action. We explore three explanations for why voter preferences do not translate into policy. First, politicians only consider acting when their initial misperceptions are particularly large. Second, elite capture prevents politicians from implementing environmental protection. Third, voters prioritize progress in other domains. Our results underscore the multiplicity of challenges facing climate action.
abstract_zh: 我们在2024年印度尼西亚大选前对选民和政治人物进行了调查，以衡量其对环境政策的偏好。我们发现，政治人物低估了选民的关切。我们对政治人物开展了一项信息实验，以纠正这些错误认知，并记录到了学习效果的证据，但并未带来对政策行动更大的支持。我们探讨了选民偏好未能转化为政策的三种解释。第一，政治人物仅在其最初的错误认知特别大时才考虑采取行动。第二，精英俘获使政治人物无法实施环境保护。第三，选民将其他领域的进展置于优先地位。我们的结果凸显了气候行动所面临的多重挑战。

title: Coordination and Commitment in International Climate Action: Evidence from Palm Oil
abstract:
Weak environmental regulation has global consequences. When domestic regulation fails, the international community can target emitters with trade policy. I develop a dynamic empirical framework for evaluating trade policy as a substitute for domestic regulation, and I apply the framework to the market for palm oil, a major driver of deforestation and global CO
2
emissions. Relative to business as usual, a domestic production tax of 50% reduces CO
2
emissions by 7.4 Gt from 1988 to 2016, amounting to 0.26 Gt annually. Coordinated, committed import tariffs of similar magnitude reduce emissions by 5.4 Gt over the same period. The cost of these import tariffs is only $15 per ton of CO
2
, even accounting for compensating transfers that recognize welfare losses for producing countries. Without coordination and commitment, import tariffs have more limited effects. Alternative policies include domestic export taxes, which are fiscally appealing independent of emission concerns, and a carbon border adjustment mechanism, which encourages domestic regulation.
abstract_zh: 环境监管薄弱会产生全球性后果。当国内监管失效时，国际社会可以通过贸易政策对排放者施压。我开发了一个动态实证框架，用于评估贸易政策作为国内监管替代手段的效果，并将该框架应用于棕榈油市场——棕榈油是导致毁林和全球二氧化碳排放的主要驱动因素。相对于照常情景，50%的国内生产税可使1988年至2016年间的CO2排放减少7.4吉吨，即年均减少0.26吉吨。协调且承诺实施的、规模相近的进口关税可使同一时期的排放减少5.4吉吨。即使考虑到为体现生产国福利损失而设立的补偿性转移支付，这些进口关税的成本也仅为每吨CO2的成本15美元。在缺乏协调与承诺的情况下，进口关税的效果较为有限。其他替代政策包括国内出口税，其在财政上具有吸引力，且不依赖于排放问题；以及碳边境调节机制，该机制能够激励国内实施监管。

title: Food Policy in a Warming World
Coastal Investment in the Age of Climate Change
Sea Level Rise and Urban Infrastructure
Sea Level Rise and Urban Inequality
Sea Level Rise and Urban Adaptation in Jakarta
Climate Change, Deforestation, and the Expansion of the Global Agricultural Frontier
abstract: This paper studies how global warming affects deforestation and agricultural land use. Using high-resolution satellite data on global temperature, deforestation, and land cover from 2001 to 2019, we find that extreme heat shocks to agricultural productivity cause large and persistent forest loss on the world’s agricultural frontier. This effect is strongest in the tropics, in areas growing the most temperature-sensitive crops, and in regions with the most inelastic demand for agricultural products, and it does not seem to be offset by international spillovers. Moreover, we show that deforestation in response to extreme heat can be explained almost entirely by cropland expansion. We corroborate these findings using agricultural census data from Brazil, where we find evidence for a mechanism whereby heat reduces yields and raises local agricultural prices, driving cropland expansion but little land use or input adjustment along other margins. Our estimates imply that extreme heat has driven substantial forest loss and that projected warming through 2100 could lead to an additional 28 million hectares of deforestation. Our findings challenge the view that reallocation will soften the environmental consequences of climate change, suggesting instead that farmers double down and expand cropland locally when productivity falls. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 本文研究全球变暖如何影响毁林和农业土地利用。利用2001年至2019年高分辨率的全球气温、毁林和土地覆盖卫星数据，我们发现，极端高温冲击对农业生产力的影响会在世界农业边界地区引发大规模且持续的森林损失。这一效应在热带地区最为强烈，在种植对温度最为敏感作物的地区最为显著，并且在农产品需求最缺乏弹性的地区最为突出，而且似乎不会被国际溢出效应所抵消。此外，我们表明，对极端高温做出的毁林反应几乎可以完全由耕地扩张来解释。我们利用巴西的农业普查数据对这些发现进行了佐证，发现了一种机制：高温降低单产并推高当地农产品价格，从而驱动耕地扩张，而在其他途径上的土地利用或投入调整则很少。我们的估计表明，极端高温已导致大量森林损失，而到2100年的预计变暖可能使毁林面积额外增加2800万公顷。我们的发现挑战了这样一种观点，即资源再配置将减轻气候变化的环境后果；相反，我们的研究表明，当生产率下降时，农民会加倍努力并在本地扩大耕地。国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Critical Minerals, Geopolitics, and the Green Transition
abstract: The green energy transition will be powered by the mining and processing of lithium, nickel, and cobalt, which are critical for the production of advanced batteries. These minerals are concentrated geographically but traded globally, allowing key mining countries to exercise market power through policy intervention. Advanced batteries use multiple minerals in combination, and this joint use creates interdependence across mineral markets. We study the geopolitical implications of these forces and their consequences for green technology adoption worldwide. We quantify supply chain vulnerability, international policy spillovers, and the potential for mineral cartels.
abstract_zh: 绿色能源转型将依靠锂、镍和钴的开采与加工提供动力，这些矿产是生产先进电池的关键。这些矿产在地理上高度集中，但在全球范围内交易，使主要矿产国能够通过政策干预行使市场势力。先进电池会组合使用多种矿产，这种联合使用造成了矿产市场之间的相互依赖。我们研究了这些力量的地缘政治影响，及其对全球绿色技术采用的后果。我们量化了供应链脆弱性、国际政策溢出效应以及矿产卡特尔的可能性。

title: Democratization and Infrastructure Investment: Evidence from Healthcare in Indonesia
Educational Investment in Spatial Equilibrium: Evidence from Indonesia
The Global Effects of Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanisms
abstract: Climate change poses a collective action problem: countries bear the costs of carbon regulation, while benefits are shared globally. Carbon border adjustment mechanisms (CBAMs) aim to realign incentives by extending domestic carbon pricing to imports. Using plant-level data for aluminum and steel, which account for 11% of global CO2 emissions, we document that emissions intensity is income-neutral and uncorrelated with production costs. Carbon pricing introduces a new margin of green comparative advantage. With a quantitative trade model, we show that CBAMs can boost domestic competitiveness, reduce emissions leakage, and facilitate collective climate action, while largely avoiding disproportionate burdens on lower-income countries. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 气候变化带来集体行动问题：各国承担碳监管的成本，而收益则由全球共享。碳边境调节机制（CBAM）旨在通过将国内碳定价延伸至进口产品，重新调整激励。利用铝和钢铁的工厂层面数据——这两个行业占全球CO2排放的11%——我们发现，排放强度与收入水平无关，也与生产成本不相关。碳定价引入了绿色比较优势的新维度。借助一个定量贸易模型，我们表明，碳边境调节机制可以提升国内竞争力，减少排放泄漏，并促进集体气候行动，同时在很大程度上避免对低收入国家造成不成比例的负担。国家经济研究局（NBER）工作论文系列的机构订阅者以及发展中国家居民可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。
